name: inspire
description: Two-stage learning loop: /inspire drops YouTube and web-article URLs and fans out one read-only subagent per link — each pulls the content (transcript or page text) via a bundled MCP server and evaluates it against the project you're working in — synthesized into docs/inspiration/; then /apply promotes the vetted leads into your project's own docs. Each stage writes only through its own path-bounded tool: /inspire the inspiration corpus, /apply the docs dir.
